skills.name: aventure-cookbook
skills.description: Use for multi-step aVenture research recipes: company briefs, funding histories, round investors, investor portfolios, founder backgrounds, competitor sets, news monitoring, and resolving a list of names.

skills.name: aventure
skills.description: Use to read aVenture research data on private companies, founders, investors, funding rounds, and news through its API, CLI, or MCP server.

skills.name: competitive-landscape
skills.description: Use to map the full competitive landscape around a company, product, or investment firm: every player class, the axes buyers trade off, a sourced player table, recent funding and M&A, open positions, and where the subject sits.

skills.name: competitor-analysis
skills.description: Use to compare a company or product head to head with its direct competitors: competitor selection with reasons, product, pricing, customers, distribution, traction, and team compared on sourced evidence, and the subject's relative strength on each dimension.

skills.name: investor-portfolio-analysis
skills.description: Use to analyze an investment firm's or individual investor's portfolio: funds and vintages, deployment by year, stage, sector, and geography, lead versus follow behavior, check sizes, verified outcomes, co-investors, stated versus revealed thesis, and recent activity.

skills.name: leadership-track-record
skills.description: Use to write a verified professional track record of a founder, executive, or investor: a dated role history, measurable outcomes during each tenure with careful attribution, board seats and investments, public record matters, and unverified claims flagged.

skills.name: market-research
skills.description: Use to write a market research report on the market a company or product sells into: market definition, size with shown arithmetic, growth, segments, buyers, pricing, regulation, and the subject's position.

skills.name: porters-five-forces
skills.description: Use to write a Porter's Five Forces analysis of the industry a company or product competes in: a defined industry boundary, each force rated with its structural drivers and evidence, the force trend, the profit implication, and the subject's position.

skills.name: swot-analysis
skills.description: Use to write an evidence-backed SWOT analysis of a company, product, or investment firm: internal strengths and weaknesses, external opportunities and threats, each specific and sourced, ranked by impact, and crossed into actions for the reader's decision.
